text: {"lessons":["Selling several positions at a gain felt rewarding, but I should base future sales on the portfolio’s needs rather than on whether a stock is above my purchase price.","After those sales I made no trades for many periods; holding can be appropriate, but I should still review each position’s risk and purpose instead of letting reluctance to act decide for me.","Small account swings and past price moves do not tell me what comes next, so I should avoid reacting to them and trade only when a reasoned change in my plan calls for it."]}
